programme.title: Live: Good Morning Football
programme.desc: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period.

programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: Overland Riders
programme.desc: Cowboy Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is riding in a stagecoach with young Jean (Patti McCarty), on his way to a business deal with her father. The coach is attacked by bandits, but luckily Fuzzy's buddy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) is in the vicinity, and he comes to the rescue, fending off the outlaws. Billy helps Jean get back home, only to learn that the bandits he's just thwarted have killed her father and pinned the crime on Fuzzy. Billy then must go after the real murderers.

programme.title: Prairie Rustlers
programme.desc: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. The leader of the cattle rustlers who killed the sheriff is named Jim (Buster Crabbe), and he bears a striking resemblance to Fuzzy's friend Billy (Buster Crabbe), much to the deputy's confusion. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him.

programme.title: Wild Country
programme.desc: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
programme.desc: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang.

programme.title: Tornado Range
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his partner, Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), escort homesteaders into Texas to settle. Determined to resist the settlement, rancher Lance King (George Chesebro) organizes the locals, despite both the caution of his daughter, Mary (Jennifer Holt), and a government document delivered by Eddie assuring the homesteaders of their rights. As confrontation brews, criminal rancher Thayer (Terry Frost) uses the conflict as a cover to seek vengeance on King.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
programme.desc: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: Fighting Man of the Plains
programme.desc: Gunslinger and former Confederate Jim Dancer (Randolph Scott) is on a mission to find his brother's killer but mistakenly shoots the wrong man, leading him to become an outlaw. Later, Dancer takes on the identity of a deceased marshal and comes into conflict with a ruthless band of criminals but receives help from a renowned old war buddy. Dancer also finally gets a chance to face off against his sibling's real murderer, Bert Slocum (Barry Kelley), in a tense showdown.

programme.title: Niagara Niagara
programme.desc: Two misfits (Robin Tunney, Henry Thomas) meet while shoplifting and set out on a mission that takes a quick downward spiral.

programme.title: Joyride
programme.desc: Three excitement-craving friends get more than they bargained for when they steal a hit woman's automobile.

programme.title: Premium
programme.desc: Reginald "Cool" Coolidge is an actor hoping for his big break away from stereotypical black roles. When his ex-fiancée, Charli, pulls in to the gas station where he works, Cool realizes that he still loves her after three years apart. But there is one problem: Charli's wedding to another man is only 36 hours away. Desperate to win her back, Cool uses his talents as an actor to convince Charli that she is choosing the wrong man.

programme.title: Fighting Man of the Plains

Later, Dancer takes on the identity of a deceased marshal and comes into conflict with a ruthless band of criminals but receives help from a renowned old war buddy. Dancer also finally gets a chance to face off against his sibling's real murderer, Bert Slocum (Barry Kelley), in a tense showdown.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it.

programme.title: Thunder Town

Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: Ambush Trail
programme.desc: Curley Thompson (Bob Steele) clashes with Hatch Bolton (I. Stanford Jolley), who is buying out small ranches in order to sell to a large grain combine. Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth.

Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), a pair of justice-minded cowboys, stumble across an attempt to rob one of Margie's coaches, and they save her loot from the villains. But, when it becomes clear that the attempted crime was part of a larger conspiracy, Eddie and Soapy must widen their investigation.

programme.desc: Ellen Williams (Lorraine Miller) has reason to be worried. Her fur-trader father has just been killed, and it looks like his murderers aim to strong-arm her into giving up the whereabouts of his stockpile of animal pelts. Apprised of the situation, Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) decide to outsmart the crook. Posing as a Native American, Panhandle sets in motion a clever plan aimed at ensnaring the bandits.

programme.title: Man From Oklahoma
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) and his partner (George "Gabby" Hayes) help a woman (Dale Evans) in distress.

programme.title: Twilight in the Sierras
programme.desc: Parole officer Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) visits his kindhearted friend Judge Wiggins (Edward Keane) at his home for rehabilitated ex-convicts. Behind the judge's back, foreman Matt Brunner (George Meeker) has been running a counterfeiting ring with the unwilling help of former prisoner Ricardo Chavez (Russ Vincent). An accident during a lion hunt causes Deputy Sheriff Pat Callahan (Dale Evans) to arrest Roy for murder, while Brunner's henchmen kidnap Chavez's visiting sister (Estelita Rodriguez).

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Dead Birds
programme.desc: William (Henry Thomas), a Confederate soldier, has gone AWOL with a crew of other men. As the group, among it a runaway slave (Isaiah Washington) and a nurse (Nicki Aycox), makes its way along, it stops off to rob a bank clean. Looking to plan a getaway, the gang heads into an empty house to hole up for the evening. As the soldiers start arguing with one another, strange things begin happening in the house -- and everyone in the group soon realizes that the place is haunted.

Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large.

It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension.

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Coming home at the end of World War I, Matt Brady (John Payne), the black-sheep brother of big-city political boss Tim Brady (Roy Roberts), is a loose cannon who gets into drunken fights and impulsively marries a total stranger, the plain but kind-hearted Lorry (Gloria McGhee). Taking over his brother's political machine after Tim's sudden death, Matt becomes powerful and extremely wealthy, but his corrupt dealings with a local gangster (Robin Morse) threaten to destroy everything he has.

programme.title: Cloudburst
programme.desc: Canadian World War II veteran John Graham (Robert Preston) works in London as a code breaker. Tragedy strikes when his pregnant wife, Carol (Elizabeth Sellars), is accidentally run over by two crooks who are speeding away from the scene of a murder. Haunted, grieving and thirsting for revenge, Graham sets out to find the two fugitive murderers. When he does, he intends to kill them, the same way they killed Carol. But will that assuage his grief?

programme.title: Hell Bound

programme.title: Crime Against Joe
programme.desc: Joe, an unemployed artist living with his mother, is suspected of murdering bar singer Irene Crescent during a drinking binge. His alibi -- that he ran into a sleepwalker and helped her home -- is denied by the sleepwalker's father. A friend, waitress Slacks, who is secretly in love with him, comes to his aid with a false alibi. When it doesn't hold up, Joe and Slacks must go in search of the real killer themselves.

programme.title: Chicago Confidential

programme.title: The Last Mile

programme.title: The Wild Party

programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Franz von Werra (Hardy Kruger) is a Luftwaffe pilot by trade, but an escape artist by necessity. When his plane is attacked over England, he initiates his first effort to break out of the POW camp only days after arriving. Transferred to a second, more secure facility, Franz nevertheless manages to tunnel out and very nearly steals an airplane before being recaptured. This time the Allies send him to be imprisoned in Canada, but he steadfastly insists that no cell will hold him.

programme.title: Beachhead
programme.desc: During World War II, four Marines land on a Pacific island to execute the rescue of French planter Bouchard (Eduard Franz) and his daughter, Nina (Mary Murphy). With Japanese soldiers hidden throughout the dense jungle landscape, the Marines face a daunting trek to reach their target and must endure even greater danger on the return trip with the two French citizens. In the end, one of the Marines, Burke (Tony Curtis), carries the responsibility of getting everyone to safety.

programme.title: Ten Seconds to Hell
programme.desc: After the end of World War II, six German soldiers return to Berlin and form a bomb disposal unit. Defusing bombs is extremely risky business, so every week the group contributes to a fund that will go to the last man standing. Only Karl Wirtz and Eric Koertner are left, and their once solid friendship is starting to crack. Adding to the tension is their rivalry over a local woman and one last job that could change everything.

programme.title: The Purple Plain
programme.desc: At the end of World War II in Burma, Canadian Royal Air Force pilot Forrester (Gregory Peck) is a loner whose bravery can't cover a streak of reckless instability. When his actions cause an injury, he is nearly transferred, but Dr. Harris (Bernard Lee) recommends pulling him from duty, due to the emotional trauma he's suffered. Forrester then accompanies Harris to a Christian missionary outpost, where he meets Anna (Win Min Than) and begins to find interest in living again.

programme.title: Kings Go Forth
programme.desc: During World War II, in a picturesque town on the French Riviera, U.S. Army Lt. Sam Loggins (Frank Sinatra) and Cpl. Britt Harris (Tony Curtis) both fall for the same local girl, the American-born Monique Blair (Natalie Wood). But when the soldiers learn that Monique and her mother (Leora Dana) had moved to France from the United States to escape discrimination against her parents' interracial marriage, each man must examine his own bigotry and prejudices.

programme.title: Pork Chop Hill
programme.desc: Because final peace negotiations are bogged down in political maneuvering, U.S. soldiers, led by Lt. Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck), are forced to assault entrenched Chinese troops. The site of battle is Pork Chop Hill, a daunting, desolate climb that gives the communist forces a clear advantage. Clash after deadly clash wears down the morale and readiness of Clemons' men, and when they ask for back up, command is neither willing to send reinforcements nor authorize a retreat.

programme.title: The Secret Invasion
programme.desc: When the Allies need expendable soldiers for a highly dangerous mission, they offer pardons to a group of criminals in exchange for their participation. Led by the brooding Maj. Richard Mace (Stewart Granger), the motley crew, including explosives expert Terence Scanlon (Mickey Rooney) and scheming tough guy Roberto Rocca (Raf Vallone), sets out to extract a defecting Italian general held captive in a Nazi-controlled area. As they get farther into German territory, the casualties start to rise.

programme.desc: Irish Republican Army member Martin Fallon (Mickey Rourke) rigs a bomb to destroy a British army convoy, but the plan goes wrong when the trucks allow a school bus to pass. programme.title: The 7th Dawn
programme.desc: After World War II, Ferris (William Holden) remains in Malaya and becomes a successful businessman. After Dhana is arrested, Ferris makes a deal to track down Ng in order to save her.

programme.title: Shake Hands With the Devil

Even though Kerry's father and roommate have both been killed by British troops, he refuses to join the Irish rebellion. However, after Kerry is unjustly imprisoned and tortured by the British "Black and Tans" special forces, he fully commits himself to the cause of Irish freedom.

programme.title: Killer's Kiss

programme.desc: Free spirit and prostitute Ilya (Melina Mercouri) lives in a Greek port city. Open and amiable, she makes friends often and easily. programme.desc: Kitty O'Day (Jean Parker) is a switchboard operator at a busy hotel where her boyfriend, Johnny (Peter Cookson), also works. Suspicious about some strange noises, she sends Johnny to her employer's apartment, where Johnny finds the boss has been murdered. Kitty is determined to find the culprit, but the hotheaded Inspector Clancy (Tim Ryan) is also on the case, and, as more bodies pile up at the hotel, the police start to throw accusations at Kitty and her amateur crime-solving crew.

programme.title: Ladybug, Ladybug
programme.desc: The teachers and students of a countryside elementary school are thrown into a panic when an air raid siren goes off, warning them of an imminent nuclear attack. They are unaware that it has gone off by mistake, and separate the children into groups -- one of which is headed by the anxious Mrs. Andrews (Nancy Marchand) -- to take them home. Harriet (Alice Playten) invites her classmates into her family's bomb shelter, but tragedy strikes when she won't allow one of her classmates to enter.

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

programme.title: The Group
programme.desc: Eight young women from the Vassar College class of 1933 rush out into the world to find exciting lives, but discover nothing is quite as they dreamed. Rather than blazing trails in art, science and literature, the friends are each variously burdened with disappointing relationships, children, aging parents and unemployment. Kay Strong (Joanna Pettet), the center of the group, gradually loses faith in the promise of their lives and, as war approaches, becomes unhinged.

programme.desc: From her window, Cheryl Draper (Barbara Stanwyck) sees a neighbor, Albert Richter (George Sanders), murder a young woman. When Cheryl goes to the police, they cannot find any evidence because Richter has hidden the body. Cheryl persists in her claims without evidence, leading concerned policeman Larry Mathews (Gary Merrill) to worry that she is becoming obsessed. After Richter becomes aware of Cheryl's accusations, he conspires to make it appear that she is insane.

programme.title: Top Banana
programme.desc: Tyrannical TV star Jerry Biffle (Phil Silvers) wants to boost the sagging ratings for his comedy series. What better way to do that than by casting a couple of hot young bodies -- Sally Peters (Judy Lynn) and Cliff Lane (Danny Scholl) -- as eye candy for the viewing public? The plan gets complicated when Jerry falls for Sally, who really loves Cliff. Adapted from the hit Broadway musical, "Top Banana" is notable for filming the actual stage production on the original sets.

While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: The Defiant Ones
programme.desc: Two men (Robert Urich, Carl Weathers) of different races, who loathe each other, escape from a chain gang shackled together.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
programme.desc: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed.

programme.title: Visit to a Chief's Son
programme.desc: When a Western anthropologist, Robert (Richard Mulligan), brings his son, Kevin (John Philip Hogdon), to Kenya to document an eclipse and a remote Masai tribe's reaction to it, both father and son are in for a serious case of culture shock. Used to Western comforts, Kevin is at first hesitant and uncomfortable among the natives, but the English-speaking son of the tribe's chief, Nemolok (Johnny Sekka), helps familiarize Kevin with his culture, opening his eyes to a new way of life.

programme.title: The Kitchen Toto
programme.desc: In the 1950s Kenya, a preacher (Nathan Dambuza Mdledle) speaks out against the Mau Mau terrorists and is killed for it, leaving his young son, Mwangi (Edwin Mahinda), to fend for himself. Mwangi goes to work in the kitchen of the local British police chief, John Graham (Bob Peck), who welcomes him -- though his wife (Phyllis Logan) and son (Ronald Pirie) treat Mwangi with contempt. Things worsen when the Mau Mau intercede in his life again, this time demanding that Mwangi ally himself with them.

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: Anna Lucasta has been walking the streets in San Diego since being thrown out of home, at 19, by her alcoholic father, Joe. She's estranged from her family, but when her father and brother-in-law see greedy potential in an arranged marriage to affluent Rudolph, Anna is called back home. Old wounds have hardly healed, though. Just as Anna starts to feel for Rudolph, Danny, an old friend, returns to make life difficult.

programme.title: Halls of Anger
programme.desc: The court-ordered desegregation of an inner-city Los Angeles high school brings 60 white students into the predominantly African-American student body. African-American teacher Quincy Davis (Calvin Lockhart) reaches out to all his students, enticing Lerone (DeWayne Jessie) to advance his reading skills with racy paperbacks, protecting new student Douglas (Jeff Bridges) after a race-motivated beating and trying to quell a potential student strike led by the militant J.T. (James A. Watson Jr.).

programme.title: Black Girl
programme.desc: The 17-year-old dreamer Billie Jean is the youngest in a family of loving yet discouraging women. Billie Jean's mother, Mama Rosie, cares deeply about her three biological children. However, her own personal disappointments have left her embittered, and she only offers encouragement to her adopted daughter, Netta. When Netta, a successful teacher, returns to visit the family, she may be the voice of guidance and hope Billie Jean desperately needs.

The pair clashes during their tense investigation as they try to track down the three suspects and apprehend them. Also searching for the fugitives is ruthless mobster Nick D'Salvio (Tony Franciosa), who will stop at nothing to retrieve the stolen money.

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Mack "Truck" Turner (Isaac Hayes) almost always finds his target, but his latest prize -- a pimp called Gator (Paul Harris) -- is killed while Turner is chasing him. Gator's girl, Dorinda (Nichelle Nichols), vows to avenge his death and offers ownership of her successful call-girl operation to anyone who can knock off Turner. Upscale pimp Harvard Blue (Yaphet Kotto) steps in, upping the ante with professional assassins. Turner, however, isn't going down easily.

programme.title: Drum
programme.desc: A slaver (Warren Oates) buys Drum (Ken Norton), a bordello queen's (Silvia Pinal) son, in the 1860s New Orleans.

programme.title: Friday Foster
programme.desc: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt.

programme.title: The Monkey Hustle
programme.desc: Slick Chicago street hustler Big Daddy Foxx (Yaphet Kotto) lives comfortably off petty confidence scams that he pulls with the help of loyal teenage acolytes Baby D' (Kirk Calloway), Tiny (Donn Harper) and Player (Thomas Carter). His business is jeopardized, however, when he runs afoul of neighborhood racketeer Goldie (Rudy Ray Moore). Their rivalry escalates until the threat of a freeway being built through their neighborhood obliges them to cooperate in order to fight city hall.

programme.title: Belle of the Yukon
programme.desc: A con man who has tried to turn over a new leaf, Honest John Calhoun (Randolph Scott) is the owner and operator of a dance hall in the north of Canada. John has hoped to evade both the police and his past, but his history catches up with him when his ex-girlfriend, Belle De Valle (Gypsy Rose Lee), appears in his venue as a member of a dance troupe. As John and Belle reunite, fellow entertainer Lettie Candless (Dinah Shore) also becomes infatuated with the suave businessman.

programme.title: Geronimo
programme.desc: Apache leader Geronimo (Chuck Connors) tires of battling American and Mexican troops, and decides to surrender his meager tribe. However, life on the San Carlos reservation is difficult, and the Apaches do not adjust well to becoming farmers. Geronimo is befriended by a schoolteacher (Kamala Devi), who tries to broaden his horizons, but corruption on the reservation forces him to take his band and head for the mountains, where the Apaches wage a doomed war against the white man.

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: The year is 1908, and aging adventurer Sam Longwood (Lee Marvin) and his gang of crooked cowboys have been cheated out of a big score by their own cohort, Jack Colby (Robert Culp). After years of searching, Sam finally tracks Colby down and decides to take revenge against his former accomplice. Sam regroups his old circle of grifters, and they hatch a scheme to get their hands on Colby's fortune; however, nothing seems to go smoothly for these ramshackle scam artists.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: Bat becomes the only remaining witness for the prosecution in an upcoming murder trial in Wyoming as the father of the accused man either intimidates or kills anyone able to testify.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: An old foe mysteriously bequeaths his casino to Bat; when Bat arrives in Shotgun Falls, Wyo., to claim the inheritance, he discovers he must deal with a crippling mortgage and a murderous marshal determined to take control of the property.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Sheriff Hollister must persuade the sole survivor of an attack on a Mexican pack train to let him deal with the outlaws.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Hollister investigates when a lawyer who wins acquittal for his client narrowly escapes death.

programme.title: Quincannon, Frontier Scout
programme.desc: Linus Quincannon (Tony Martin) quits the U.S. Army in protest at the slaughter of Native Americans. He becomes a frontier scout, and is sent on an expedition to look into the disappearance of a cargo of munitions. He's joined by the lovely Maylene (Peggie Castle), who wants to find out if her brother died in an attack on a faraway fort. In a savage environment of hostile American Indians and renegade soldiers, Quincannon searches for the truth, and Maylene falls in love with him.

programme.title: Blazing Guns
programme.desc: The governor sends the Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) to tame a cow town.

programme.title: The Iron Sheriff
programme.desc: When his son Benjie is accused of killing a stagecoach driver, Sheriff Sam Galt is convinced his boy is innocent. On a quest to clear his son's name, Galt spares no expense in hiring lawyers. While Galt's position as town sheriff raises suspicions of police misconduct, he makes it clear he won't stand in the way of the law. But that certainty is thrown into doubt when Galt goes on a search for the real murderer -- and makes a startling discovery.

programme.title: Rebel in Town
programme.desc: Bedloe Mason and his four sons ride into an Arizona outpost after robbing a bank. When they hear a gun go off behind them, one son immediately turns around and shoots to kill. But his victim turns out to be a young boy with a toy gun, so the Masons hightail it out of town, save for Bedloe's son Gray, who feels guilty and stays to see the kid buried. Yet Gray's presence only stirs up more trouble as the child's father, John, looks for violent revenge.

programme.title: The Law Rides Again
programme.desc: The Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) use a convict (Jack LaRue) to trap a crooked Indian agent.

programme.title: Robbery Under Arms
programme.desc: Two brothers join their father in Captain Starlight's (Peter Finch) bushranger gang in 19th-century Australia.

programme.title: A Dog's Best Friend
programme.desc: Married ranchers (Bill Williams, Marcia Henderson) take in an ungrateful boy (Roger Mobley) who befriends a slain hermit's German shepherd.

programme.title: War Drums
programme.desc: Mangas Coloradas (Lex Barker), an Apache chief, and white trader Luke Fargo (Ben Johnson) are bound by friendship and their mutual love for Riva (Joan Taylor), a Mexican-Native American girl rescued from horse thieves. Riva marries Mangas, who teaches her the warrior's ways, and she later warns the Apaches of an ambush by white soldiers. When Fargo, who did not intend an attack, is injured, Riva helps him -- a kindness he must choose whether or not to return when war with the Apaches erupts.

programme.title: Gun Fever
programme.desc: After growing up living a life of crime, outlaw Sam Weller (John Lupton) decides to go straight, but neither Sam's father, Trench (Aaron Saxon), nor his thieving cohort, Charlie Whitman (Norman Frederic), take the news well. After Sam invests in a way station with his friend, Luke Ram (Mark Stevens), Trench and Whitman convince a band of Sioux warriors to attack the station. Although Simon eventually forges a peace agreement with the Sioux, a final battle with Trench looms on the horizon.

Martin discovers that his late mother had been cheated out of her homestead by Canby Judd (William Bishop), who is now affianced to Martin's childhood sweetheart, Laura Mead (Karin Booth). programme.title: The Exorcist
programme.desc: One of the most profitable horror movies ever made, this tale of an exorcism is based loosely on actual events. The priest makes a request to perform an exorcism, and the church sends in an expert (Max von Sydow) to help with the difficult job.

programme.title: Beyond the Gates
programme.desc: "Beyond the Gates" is set in a leafy Maryland suburb just outside of Washington D.C., and in one the most affluent African American counties in the United States. At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. programme.desc: Les Pierrafeu étaient la famille moderne de l'âge de la Pierre. Résidant dans la ville Saint-Granit, Fred Caillou n'était pas satisfait de son travail à la carrière, mais revenait à la maison auprès de sa charmante épouse Wilma et, enfin de sa fille Agathe. Fred, un grand amateur de golf et de quilles aimait aussi taquiner son voisin Arthur Laroche, tandis que la femme coquine d'Arthur, Bertha était la meilleure amie de Wilma. Au cours de l'émission, Barney et Betty ont adopté un fils anormalement fort, Bamm-Bamm, qui allait devenir plus tard ami avec Agathe. Les Pierrafeu, fortement inspiré par "The Honeymooners" ont convaincu une génération d'enfants que dinosaures et humains ont occupé la planète en même temps.

programme.title: Les Pierrafeu
programme.desc: Les Pierrafeu étaient la famille moderne de l'âge de la Pierre. Résidant dans la ville Saint-Granit, Fred Caillou n'était pas satisfait de son travail à la carrière, mais revenait à la maison auprès de sa charmante épouse Wilma et, enfin de sa fille Agathe. Fred, un grand amateur de golf et de quilles aimait aussi taquiner son voisin Arthur Laroche, tandis que la femme coquine d'Arthur, Bertha était la meilleure amie de Wilma. Au cours de l'émission, Barney et Betty ont adopté un fils anormalement fort, Bamm-Bamm, qui allait devenir plus tard ami avec Agathe. Les Pierrafeu, fortement inspiré par "The Honeymooners" ont convaincu une génération d'enfants que dinosaures et humains ont occupé la planète en même temps.

programme.title: Sur le front
programme.sub-title: Métaux rares: les ressources cachées de la France
programme.desc: On a été marqué de voir des entreprises européennes suspendre leur production quelque temps en novembre 2025, parce que la Chine a cessé de fournir des terres rares. On a découvert que l'UE avait aussi lancé une cinquantaine de projets miniers à la recherche de minerais stratégiques. On a voulu comprendre ce qu'il se passait : qu'est-ce qui se trouve dans notre sous-sol? Sur quels métaux allons-nous pouvoir compter pour retrouver notre souveraineté, pour être compétitifs?

programme.title: Les gardiens de l'eau

programme.title: Le jardin extraordinaire
programme.desc: Direction la Slovénie, état d'Europe centrale rassemblant toute la diversité biologique du vieux continent : de vastes forêts, des grottes majestueuses, un littoral exotique et de hautes montagnes. Petit par sa taille, le pays est grand par son envie de faire cohabiter l'Homme avec la faune locale.

Malgré sa réticence, il découvre qu'il n'est pas à la hauteur du charme et de l'esprit désarmant de Sophie.

programme.desc: Pendant des années, Nathan Harper a eu le sentiment qu'il y avait quelque chose de bizarre avec sa famille. Alors qu'il s'apprête à découvrir sa véritable identité, Nathan devient la cible d'assassins qui l'obligent à fuir avec sa voisine, Karen, la seule personne digne de confiance.

programme.title: Game On With Blaine Anthony

programme.title: Yamaha's Whitetail Diaries

programme.sub-title: Capitán republicano y la liberación de Robert Swift
programme.desc: El riojano Pedro Escobal fue defensa y capitán del Real Madrid y acudió a unos Juegos Olímpicos con la selección española. Una vez retirado, la Guerra Civil le encontró en Logroño. Fue encarcelado al poco de empezar debido a sus ideas republicanas. Recorrió varias prisiones, en las que estuvo cerca de la muerte, y vivió unas experiencias estremecedoras que pudo relatar una vez exiliado en un libro autobiográfico llamado 'Las Sacas'.

programme.desc: En tiempos de confinamiento, Raúl, encerrado en su casa, echa la vista atrás para recordar todas aquellas historias que ha contado a lo largo de su trayecto profesional en las pantallas de Movistar +. programme.title: 90 años de LaLiga
programme.desc: Abel Resino ostenta el récord de imbatibilidad de la historia de LaLiga. Como jugador del Atlético de Madrid entró el libro Guiness al mantener su portería a cero durante 1275 minutos, los que van desde el 25 de noviembre de 1990, en el que Claudio le marcó un gol en el Mallorca-Atlético y el 17 de marzo de 1991, en la jornada 26, cuando Luis Enrique consiguió superarle el minuto 45 del Atlético-Sporting de Gijón disputado en el Vicente Calderón. Un total de 14 partidos consecutivos sin encajar un gol en la temporada 1990/1991. Una marca aún vigente en el futbol profesional y que le ayudó a ganar el trofeo Zamora con 17 goles recibidos en 33 partidos. Campeón de la Copa del Rey, en 1995 decidió fichar por el Rayo Vallecano de Madrid para disputar su última temporada en activo. Abel disputó un total de 264 partidos en la máxima categoría del fútbol español.

programme.title: El fútbol según Raúl
programme.desc: Capta la esencia de la Tacita de Plata y de su gente tratando el fútbol (y lo que no es el fútbol: carnaval, guasa, arte) a través de bloques generacionales (el Cádiz de los ascensos de los 70 de Baena, el de los 80 de Mágico y Mejías, el de los 90 de Kiko, Mami y Arteaga que siempre se salvaba en la última jornada, y así hasta el Cádiz de Cervera del último ascenso) y personajes (Rovira, Macarty, Manolo Santander). Es un recorrido por sus hitos futbolísticos y sus gentes para descubrir por qué el Cádiz y Cádiz son tan especiales.

programme.title: LaLiga EA Sports

programme.title: Informe Robinson
programme.desc: El Cambados de Sito Miñanco. A finales de los años ochenta, el equipo de fútbol de la pequeña localidad de Cambados llegó a convertirse en el tercero de Galicia. El esplendor del Xuventude Cambados comenzó a partir del momento en que Sito Miñanco se hizo cargo de él. A base de dinero, consiguió sacarlo de la Regional Preferente para ponerlo a las puertas de la Segunda División. Treinta años más tarde, y con Sito Miñanco de nuevo detenido por narcotráfico, el ejemplo de aquel equipo se ha convertido en el mejor reflejo de lo que fueron los años de esplendor del tráfico de cocaína en Galicia. Una época que dejó cicatrices que aún no se han cerrado.

programme.title: Paulo Futre, el portugués
programme.desc: En 1987 se produjo uno de los fichajes más importantes de la historia de La Liga. El Atlético de Madrid se hizo con el jugador más deseado del momento: Paulo Futre, reciente campeón de Europa con el Oporto. Arranca entonces una relación entre club y jugador a los que el paso del tiempo ha convertido en inseparables. Décadas después, el recuerdo de su fútbol pasa de generación en generación y convierte a Futre en bandera y escudo de toda una afición.

programme.title: El fútbol según Raúl
programme.desc: El 4 de junio de 1980 vivimos un partido histórico en el fútbol español, porque nunca se había disputado y nunca más se disputará. Esa noche saltaban al césped del Santiago Bernabéu los jugadores del Real Madrid y los once de su filial para disputar la final de la Copa del Rey. 40 años después Raúl se propone contarnos aquella historia del Castilla matagigantes y qué fue de los jugadores que vivieron aquella noche tan especial.

programme.title: El fútbol según Raúl
programme.desc: De Segunda División a levantar cinco Europa Leagues. En menos de 15 años, el Sevilla se ha convertido en uno de los grandes del viejo continente. La suya es una historia de gloria, pero también de dolor porque durante los últimos años el club se ha visto sacudido por los fallecimientos de Puerta y Reyes, dos canteranos que fueron esenciales en el resurgimiento del equipo nervionense. Con la ayuda de Monchi, denominador común de todos los triunfos del Sevilla, Raúl nos relata el camino hacia la cima y nos transmite la idiosincrasia de la entidad.

programme.title: El Gancho de Daimiel: Pedro Martínez
programme.desc: Antoni Daimiel tiene una charla con uno de los entrenadores de moda de la Liga Endesa, con uno de los equipos que más ha sorprendido en lo que llevamos de temporada, el Baxi Manresa. Es uno de los grandes entrenadores que ha dado nuestro país y ha vuelto a Manresa para llevar al club a una temporada que está siendo excepcional. Metió al BAXI Manresa en la Copa del Rey, mantiene al equipo tercero en la competición regular y mucho tendrían que torcerse las cosas para que no fuera equipo de playoffs. Pedro Martínez tiene mucho que contar y se cita con Antoni Daimiel para explicar los detalles de una vida intensa en los banquillos.

La Virtus de Alex Mumbrú llega lanzada tras sus tres triunfos sobre Paris, Bayern y Olympiakos.

programme.title: Forbidden Apple
programme.desc: يسلط مسلسل (التفاحة المحرمة) الضوء ضمن أحداثه على عالم رجال الأعمال والثراء الفاحش، والصراع الذي يصنعه الحب من جانب، وسيطرة المال على البشر من جانب آخر. The events highlight the world of businessmen and extreme wealth, the conflict created by love on the one hand, and the control of money over people on the other.(n)

programme.title: حادث قلب
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل في قالب من الرومانسية والدراما حول قصة فتاة ثرية تعيش حياة سعيدة، لكن وقوع حادث سير لها سيغيّر حياتها ويقلبها رأسًا على عقب، فماذا سيحدث لها. A rich girl, who’s leading a quiet, happy life, gets into an accident that turns her whole world upside down.(n)

programme.title: بهو الست لميا
programme.desc: في إطار كوميدي، تتمحور الأحداث حول شخصية الست لميا ومساعدها أبو شادي، والفندق الذي تديره، حيث يجمع شخصيات متنوعة من خلفيات اجتماعية وثقافية مختلفة. تنشأ بينهم سلسلة من المفارقات اليومية والمواقف الطريفة المشوقة، والتي تعكس تفاصيل الحياة اليومية بأسلوب ساخر ومرح.(n)

programme.title: Cranberry Sorbet
programme.desc: تعيش (دوجا) مع والدتها وأختها، ثم تنشأ علاقة حب قوية بينها وبين (فاتح) الذي ينتمي لطبقة أرستقراطية، لكن تقف هذه الاختلافات الطبقية والثقافية عائقًا أمام حبهما المتوهج. Doga lives with her mother and sister, and then an intense romance develops between her and Fatih, who belongs to an aristocratic class, but these class and cultural differences stand in the way of their love.(n)

programme.title: صار الوقت ج6
programme.desc: يستمر البرنامج أسبوعيا، في موسمه السادس، ويقدمه الإعلامي والمحامي (مرسال غانم) على شاشة ال MTV، ويتعرض للعديد من القضايا السياسية التي تهم المواطنين في البلاد. The program continues weekly, in its sixth season, and is presented by journalist and lawyer Marcel Ghanem on MTV Lebanon, as it addresses many political issues that concern citizens of the country.

programme.title: جدل
programme.desc: برنامج حواري يقدمه ماريو عبود، يتناول قضايا سياسية واقتصادية واجتماعية ويعكس هموم المواطنين ويحاول تقديم الحلول لمشاكلهم. A talk show presented by Mario Abboud that addresses political, economic, and social issues, reflects the concerns of citizens, and attempts to provide solutions to their problems.(n)

programme.title: دورة جونية جبيل
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث في إطار كوميدي متصل منفصل حول سائق أتوبيس يعمل على خط “دورة -جونية-جبيل” والذي يتعرض بسبب ظروف عمله لأحداث كثيرة، منها كوميدية ومنها رومانسية. In a series of separate episodes, a bus driver on the Daoura-Jounieh-Byblos line is exposed to many events, including comedic and romantic ones.(n)

programme.title: بيروت 303
programme.desc: تتفجر طائرة بيروت 303 فوق شاطئ لبنان، فتحول حياة القلة من الناجين إلى رحلة بحث عن الحقيقة، ضمن إطار غامض ومليء بالشك. The Beirut 303 plane explodes over the coast of Lebanon, turning the life of the few survivors into a truth-searching journey.(n)

programme.title: نهاركم سعيد
programme.desc: برنامج صباحي يومي، يهتم بمناقشة آخر المستجدات على الساحة السياسية، من خلال إستضافة المحليين السياسيين، لمناقشة القضايا التي تهم الرأي العام في لبنان. كان البرنامج عند انطلاقته بعام 1996 يتناول الأحداث السياسية بفقرة صغيرة مدتها نصف ساعة وبقية فترة البرنامج كانت حول أمور ثقافية ومنوعة. A regular morning program that hosts local politicians to talk about subjects that are important to the people in Lebanon and to debate the latest events in the political scene. When it was launched in 1996, the program dealt with political events in a small segment lasting half an hour, and the rest of the program period was about cultural and other matters.(n)

programme.title: لولا الحب
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول الفتاة مسا (نادين الراسي) التي تعمل وسط مجال إعلامي كبير وتستغل تلك الوظيفة في تسليط الضوء على مجموعة من القضايا والمشاكل الهامة في المجتمع متحدية العديد من الشخصيات ذو السلطة والنفوذ.. في ذات الوقت تحاول اتخاذ قرار بشأن علاقتها غير الشرعية وحملها. The series revolves around Missa, who works in a large media field and sheds light on a range of important issues and problems in society in defiance of many figures with power and influence, while she tries to decide on her affair and pregnancy.(n)

programme.title: حدوتة حب
programme.desc: في إطار درامي تدور الأحداث حول أربع قصص (الشهر السابع، طفلي المتوحد، شهر عسل، الهاجس) يجمع بينهما دافع الانتقام والخيانة. programme.title: علاقات خاصة
programme.desc: يجسد كل زوجين قصة درامية تتشابك أحداثها بشكل أو بأخر مع العلاقات الأخرى بدءًا من «جو» رجل الأعمال المتزوج من «ياسمين» التي تنتمي لبيئة فقيرة ليصنع منها نجمة غناء، وترتبط حياة «جو وياسمين» بـ «حسام» المتزوج من «فرح»، بالرغم من رفض أهلها لهذا الزواج بسبب فارق السن، أما «جهاد» فيقع ضحية إنتقام مزدوج من أخته «رنا» و«إياد» حبيب زوجته المستقبلية «لامار»، أمّا «تيم» فيحب «مايا» رغم اختلاف الديانة. The events of each couple's story are intertwined with other relationships, starting with Jo, a businessman married to Yasmin, who becomes a singing star. Hossam who is married to Farah. While Jehad is the victim of double revenge from his sister Rana and Eiad. As for Tayem, he's in love with Maya despite having a different religion.

programme.title: Barbaros: Sword of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: يحكي المسلسل قصة حياة البحار خير الدين بربروس، الذي صنع بطولات لا تنسى للإمبراطورية العثمانية في عهد السلطان سليم الأول، والذي ضمن السيادة العثمانية في البحر الأبيض المتوسط، وكان من أكبر مؤيدي خير الدين بربروس شقيقه عروج بربروس الذي تمكن من السيطرة على جميع السواحل. The story of the life of the sailor Hayreddin Pasha "Barbarossa" and his unforgettable heroics for the Ottoman Empire during the reign of Sultan Selim I, which guaranteed Ottoman sovereignty in the Mediterranean. One of Barbarossa's biggest supporters was his brother Oruc, who managed to control all the coasts.(n)

programme.title: أولاد الراعي
programme.desc: من نقطة الصفر وجذور بسيطة، ينطلق ثلاثة أشقاء في رحلة كفاح مريرة لبناء إمبراطورية تجارية تهز عالم المال. ومع تضخم الثروة والنفوذ، يتحول النجاح إلى اختبار قاسٍ لروابط الدم؛ حيث تتشابك المصالح وتنفجر صراعات السلطة والولاء بينهم. يضعهم العمل أمام خيارات مصيرية تهدد الكيان الذي بنوه معاً، كاشفاً كيف يمكن للمال أن يغير القلوب ويقلب الأشقاء إلى خصوم في ساحة معركة لا ترحم. From scratch, three brothers embark on a bitter struggle to build a business empire. As wealth grows, success turns into a severe test of blood ties, where interests intertwine and power and loyalty struggles clash between them. The brothers are faced with fateful choices that threaten the entity they built together, revealing how money can turn siblings into opponents on a merciless battlefield.(n)

programme.title: The Best Thing
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث حول (شين شيفان)، مديرة فندق مهووسة بالعمل، تلتقي بالطبيب الهادئ (خه سو يه) أثناء بحثها عن علاج. ورغم أن علاقتهما تبدأ طبيعية، فإن الصدفة تجمعهما كجيران، فتتطور بينهما مشاعر حب. The events revolve around Shen Xifan, a workaholic hotel manager, who meets the quiet doctor He Su Ye while searching for a cure. Although their relationship begins professionally, coincidence brings them together as neighbors, and feelings of love develop between them.(n)

programme.title: كرڤان
programme.desc: برنامج شبابي يذاع على قناة رؤيا الفضائية يستعرض كل ما يهم الشباب من أخبار على مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي مثل أمور الموضة والطبخ وهموم الحياة ويتم فيه أيضًا عمل إستفتاءات غريبة. A youth program broadcast on Roya TV that shows all the news that concerns young people on social networking sites, such as fashion, cooking, and life concerns, and strange polls are also conducted.(n)

programme.title: نقطة انتهى
programme.desc: يجاهد الصيدلي (فارس يعقوب) من أجل إخفاء جريمته الأولى التي ارتكبها عن طريق الخطأ بحق شقيق زوجته المراهق، فيما تسعى زوجته إلى كشف حقيقة مقتل شقيقها الوحيد. The pharmacist, Fares Yacoub, struggles to hide his first crime, which he committed by mistake against the teenage brother of his wife, who seeks to uncover the truth about the murder of her only brother.(n)

programme.title: رسوم متحركة
programme.desc: السنافر شخصيات خيالية صغيرة الحجم، زرقاء اللون، وتعيش في الغابة، تمثل عائلة السنافر الكثير من الشخصيات مختلفة الطباع، والسنافر كثر. للسنافر عدو كريه هو شرشبيل الشرير وقطه الأحمر المشاكس "هرهور" اللذان يعيشان في القلعة المهجورة. The Smurfs are small, blue-colored creatures living in mushroom houses in an enchanted forest. Their peaceful life is constantly interrupted by the evil wizard Gargamel and his nasty cat Azrael who live in an abandoned castle.(n)

programme.title: خبز وملح
programme.desc: يعالج المسلسل مشكلة السمنة التي باتت ظاهرة سلبية تشغل المجتمعات العربية والقائمين على وسائل الإعلام فيها و يهتم بالصحة العامة ويقدم النصيحة الطبية والمعلومة الصحية للمشاهدين، من خلال عائلة تعاني من مشاكل صحية مختلفة بسبب عاداتهم الغذائية السيئة. The series addresses the problem of obesity, which has become a negative phenomenon that preoccupies Arab societies and the media. It focuses on public health and provides medical advice and health information to viewers, through a family suffering from various health problems due to their poor eating habits.(n)

programme.title: نبض البلد
programme.desc: برنامج سياسي يتناول العديد من القضايا المحلية والعربية والعالمية، يستضيف متخصصين ويعرض تقارير ميدانية ويتواصل مع الجمهور من خلال التعليقات عبر مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي ويطرحها على الضيوف خلال الحلقة. A political program that addresses many local, Arab, and international issues. It hosts specialists, presents field reports, communicates with the public through comments on social media sites, and presents them to the guests during episodes.(n)

programme.title: أبناء القهر
programme.desc: يعيش الزوجان عصام ورجاء في حالة كبيرة من الشجار والخلاف والشقاق بسبب رغبة زميلته في العمل في الزواج منه، وهذا الخلاف يترك مع الوقت آثاره السلبية على أولادهما. Essam and Rajaa are a married couple who experiences unsolvable problems and disputes because one of Essam's co-workers wants to marry him. These disputes affect their children negatively over time.(n)

programme.title: النويلاتي
programme.desc: في حارة النوياتي التي تغلي بصراعات السلطة والمال، تنطلق حكاية يمتزج فيها الواقع بالأساطير. يعود الغواص من وراء قضبان سجن وُصف بالمقبرة، عائدا بهوية غامضة ووجه غريب ليخترق الحارة من جديد. لا يسعى الغواص للانتقام من الذين خانوه فحسب، بل يقتفي أثر "كنز مفقود" يُقال إنه محروس بطلسم قديم. وفي ظل هذه الظروف القاسية تتقاطع الدروب مع مكائد تجار الدماء، حيث تصبح الهوية المزيفة هي الدرع الوحيد بمعركة البقاء. In the Al Nwaylati neighborhood unfolds a tale where reality and myth intertwine. Ghawwas comes out of prison, seeking not only revenge against those who betrayed him but also pursues a lost treasure. Amidst these harsh circumstances, his path crosses with the machinations of ruthless profiteers, making his assumed identity his only shield in the battle for survival.(n)

programme.title: فن الحرب
programme.desc: يختار زياد طريق التمثيل بدلًا من الانضمام إلى أعمال والده، لكن خيانة مفاجئة تؤدي إلى انهيار إمبراطورية العائلة ودخول والده السجن. وبعد وفاة والده، يعود زياد مصممًا على استرداد الأموال المسروقة واستعادة اسم العائلة، مستعينًا بموهبته في التمثيل وحيله الذكية للانتقام ممن دمّروا حياتهم. ومع اقترابه من هدفه، يجد نفسه عالقًا في لعبة مزدوجة خطيرة، خاصة حين تقع دينا، ابنة عدوه، في حبه وتساعده سرًا. Ziad chooses acting instead of joining his father’s business, but a sudden betrayal leads to the collapse of the family empire. After his father’s death, Ziad returns determined to recover the stolen money and restore the family name, using his acting skills and clever schemes against those who ruined their lives. But as he gets close to his goal, he becomes trapped in a dangerous double game.(n)

programme.title: الكبير أوي ج8
programme.desc: في هذا الجزء من المسلسل، يتعرض (الكبير أوي) عمدة قرية (المزاريطة) لضغوط عديدة، حيث يجد نفسه مضطرًا للاهتمام بقضايا ومشاكل من حوله، ويتعرض لمواقف كوميدية. Al-Kabir, the mayor of the village of Mazarita, is exposed to many pressures. He finds himself forced to pay attention to the issues and problems of those around him, and he is exposed to comical situations.(n)

programme.title: فن الحرب
programme.desc: يختار زياد طريق التمثيل بدلًا من الانضمام إلى أعمال والده، لكن خيانة مفاجئة تؤدي إلى انهيار إمبراطورية العائلة ودخول والده السجن. وبعد وفاة والده، يعود زياد مصممًا على استرداد الأموال المسروقة واستعادة اسم العائلة، مستعينًا بموهبته في التمثيل وحيله الذكية للانتقام ممن دمّروا حياتهم. ومع اقترابه من هدفه، يجد نفسه عالقًا في لعبة مزدوجة خطيرة، خاصة حين تقع دينا، ابنة عدوه، في حبه وتساعده سرًا. programme.title: برنامج ترفيهي
programme.desc: برنامج كاميرا خفية تقديم "تميم يونس"، يستضيف في كل حلقة نجماً أو نجمة في استوديو وهمي، حيث يضعهم في مواقف غريبة تتصاعد تدريجياً لتكشف عن ردود أفعالهم الحقيقية. معتمداً على الكيمياء بين تميم وضيوفه من الفنانين، ليحول اللقاء من حوار جاد إلى فوضى عارمة ومضحكة تنتهي بكشف المقلب. In each episode, Tameem Younis hosts a celebrity guest in a mock studio, placing them in increasingly bizarre situations that gradually reveal their true reactions. programme.title: لعلهم يفقهون
programme.desc: برنامج ديني، يقدمه كل من الشيخ خالد الجندي والشيخ رمضان عبد المعز، ويناقش البرنامج كافة قضايا المجتمع والشباب والدين اﻹسلامي، والاختلاف المذهبي والفقهي. A religious program presented by Sheikh Khaled Al Jundi and Sheikh Ramadan Abdel Moez, in which they discuss all issues of society, youth, the Islamic religion, and sectarian and jurisprudential differences.(n)

programme.title: العائدون
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث حول محاولات المخابرات المصرية التصدي للإرهاب متمثلًا في داعش، حيث يقوم العاملون بالمخابرات من ضباط وخبراء اتصال وعملاء سريين كلٌ بدوره في عمليات تهدف إلى حماية الوطن والقضاء على الإرهاب. The events revolve around the attempts of the Egyptian intelligence to confront terrorism represented by ISIS, as the intelligence workers, including officers, communication experts, and secret agents, perform their roles in operations aimed at protecting the homeland and eliminating terrorism.(n)

programme.title: قسمة العدل
programme.desc: في إطار درامي تشويقي، يتناول العمل صراع ثلاثة أشقاء على أملاك وثروة والدهم الحي، بينما تقف أختهم الوحيدة بين أطماعهم المتصاعدة، لتظل النهاية معلقة بسؤال: من ينتصر في هذا الصراع العائلي. It follows the struggle of three brothers over the property and wealth of their living father, while their only sister stands between their rising ambitions, leaving the ending hanging by the question: Who wins in this family conflict.(n)

programme.title: بدون سابق إنذار
programme.desc: تتدهور العلاقة بين الزوجين (مروان) و(ليلى) وتصل إلى نفق مسدود بالرغم من محاولتهما لإصلاحها، ولكن تأخذ الأمور منعطفًا صادمًا حينما يكتشفا إصابة ابنهما بسرطان الدم، وتتوالى الأحداث. The relationship between the married couple Marwan and Laila deteriorates and reaches a dead end despite their attempts to fix it. However, things take a shocking turn when they discover that their son has leukemia.(n)

programme.title: حكايات لطيفة
programme.desc: برنامج تقدمه الفنانة (لطيفة) حيث تستضيف أحد نجوم الغناء من مصر أو العالم العربي حيث يستعرض أهم المحطات الفنية في حياته وبعض جوانب حياته الشخصية بجانب تقديمه العديد من الأغاني على مدار الحلقة. A program presented by artist Latifa, in which she hosts a singing star from Egypt or the Arab world, as they review the most important artistic milestones in their careers and some aspects of their personal lives, in addition to performing a number of songs throughout the episode.(n)

programme.title: هي وبس

programme.desc: برنامج منوعات يهدف للحفاظ على الهوية المصرية وإحيائها وسط المتغيرات السياسية والاجتماعية، وذلك من خلال استضافة نوعيات مختلفة من الضيوف كالنجوم وصناع الفن بكل فروعه، وكذلك نجوم الرياضة المصرية وصناع الموسيقى الذين يقدمون مشاريعهم الموسيقية المتميزة والمتفردة عبر البرنامج. A variety show that hosts a range of guests, including stars, artists, prominent Egyptian athletes, and musicians who showcase their distinctive and original musical projects to preserve and revitalize the Egyptian identity in the face of political and social change.(n)

programme.title: لعلهم يفقهون
programme.desc: برنامج ديني، يقدمه كل من الشيخ خالد الجندي والشيخ رمضان عبد المعز، ويناقش البرنامج كافة قضايا المجتمع والشباب والدين اﻹسلامي، والاختلاف المذهبي والفقهي. A religious program presented by Sheikh Khaled Al Jundi and Sheikh Ramadan Abdel Moez, in which they discuss all issues of society, youth, the Islamic religion, and sectarian and jurisprudential differences.(n)

programme.title: العائدون
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث حول محاولات المخابرات المصرية التصدي للإرهاب متمثلًا في داعش، حيث يقوم العاملون بالمخابرات من ضباط وخبراء اتصال وعملاء سريين كلٌ بدوره في عمليات تهدف إلى حماية الوطن والقضاء على الإرهاب. The events revolve around the attempts of the Egyptian intelligence to confront terrorism represented by ISIS, as the intelligence workers, including officers, communication experts, and secret agents, perform their roles in operations aimed at protecting the homeland and eliminating terrorism.(n)

programme.title: قسمة العدل
programme.desc: في إطار درامي تشويقي، يتناول العمل صراع ثلاثة أشقاء على أملاك وثروة والدهم الحي، بينما تقف أختهم الوحيدة بين أطماعهم المتصاعدة، لتظل النهاية معلقة بسؤال: من ينتصر في هذا الصراع العائلي. The relationship between the married couple Marwan and Laila deteriorates and reaches a dead end despite their attempts to fix it. programme.title: مساء DMC
programme.desc: برنامج توك شو يعرض على شاشة DMC ويقدمه الإعلامي أسامة كمال وإيمان الحصري، ويقدم البرنامج تغطية عامة شاملة لكل الأخبار التي تخص مصر والدول العربية والعالم. programme.title: الإمام الطيب
programme.desc: برنامج يقدمه شيخ الأزهر أحمد الطيب، يتناول فيه عدد من القضايا التي تهم المجتمع المصري والعربي، والمسلمين وغير المسلمين، ومن بينها قضايا المرأة والشباب والإلحاد والإرهاب. A program presented by Grand Imam of Al Azhar, Ahmed El Tayeb, in which he addresses several issues of concern to Egyptian and Arab society, Muslims and non-Muslims, including issues of women, youth, atheism, and terrorism.(n)

programme.title: فرصة أخيرة
programme.desc: يجد قاضٍ مشهود له بالنزاهة نفسه أمام اختبار مصيري يضعه على المحك؛ حين تُختطف حفيدته للمساومة على عدالته، فيصبح محاصراً بين غريزة إنقاذها وبين الثبات على مبادئه التي عاش يدافع عنها. A judge known for his integrity finds himself facing a fateful dilemma that puts him to the test. When his granddaughter is kidnapped to sway his ruling, he becomes trapped between the instinct to save her and upholding his principles that he lived to defend.(n)

programme.title: شارع شريف ج4
programme.desc: يقدم البرنامج فقرات ترفيهية ومتنوعة بشكل جديد ومختلف، ومنها فقرات (فن، مطبخ، فاشون شو، أبراج وطاقة، أطفال، أعياد ميلاد)، وذلك من خلال ديكور البرنامج وهو عبارة عن شارع ممتد محاكاة للشارع الحقيقي الذي يحتوي على كوافير إلى جانب مطعم وأماكن للمشاة وللجلوس وعيادة. The program presents various entertainment segments in a new and different way, including art, cooking, fashion, horoscopes, children, and birthdays, through the set design of the program, which is an extended street simulating a real street, which contains a hairdresser, along with a restaurant, pedestrian areas and a clinic.(n)

programme.title: فرصة أخيرة
programme.desc: يجد قاضٍ مشهود له بالنزاهة نفسه أمام اختبار مصيري يضعه على المحك؛ حين تُختطف حفيدته للمساومة على عدالته، فيصبح محاصراً بين غريزة إنقاذها وبين الثبات على مبادئه التي عاش يدافع عنها. A judge known for his integrity finds himself facing a fateful dilemma that puts him to the test. When his granddaughter is kidnapped to sway his ruling, he becomes trapped between the instinct to save her and upholding his principles that he lived to defend.(n)

programme.title: الستات ميعرفوش يكدبوا
programme.desc: برنامج نسائي يومي يتضمن العديد من الفقرات التي تهم المرأة من طبخ ومكياج وموضة بالإضافة إلى فقرات أخرى خاصة بالسياسة والاقتصاد وكل القضايا الاجتماعية ولكن بعيون النساء، وأيضًا يستضيف العديد من الضيوف الذين يتم محاورتهم حول كل ما يهم الأسرة والمرأة بشكل خاص. Geared towards women, this daily program consists of a variety of segments related to cooking, beauty and fashion as well as other featured segments on politics, economics and social issues, explored from the perspective of women. The program also hosts a variety of guests who discuss a full range of topics, especially issues concerning women and their families.(n)

programme.title: وتر حساس ج2
programme.desc: في الموسم الثاني، يعود رشيد إلى وطنه ساعيًا لاستعادة مكانته داخل عائلته عبر الزواج من ابنة عمه فريدة. لكن زواجهما يكشف عن أسرار صراع قديم بين رشيد ووالد فريدة، لتشتعل الخلافات العائلية تدريجيًا. ومع خروج كاميليا من السجن، تبدأ مواجهة جديدة تتشابك فيها مشاعر الحب والانتقام، ليتحول العمل إلى صراع إنساني واجتماعي تتداخل فيه القيم والعواطف في أجواء مثيرة. In season 2, Rashid returns to his homeland, seeking to restore his status within his family by marrying his cousin, Farida. However, their marriage reveals the secrets of an old conflict between Rashid and Farida's father, gradually escalating family disputes. With Camelia's release from prison, a new confrontation begins, intertwining feelings of love and revenge.(n)

programme.title: ستهم
programme.desc: بعدما يُقتل زوجها، تدخل (ستهم) في عدة صراعات مع أسرتها وتحاول تربية أبناءها بعيدا عن المشاكل، ثم تضطر للتنكر في هيئة رجل حتى تواجه الصعوبات التي تقابلها في الحياة. After her husband is killed, Settohom gets into several conflicts with her family and tries to raise her children away from problems; however, she is forced to disguise herself as a man to face the difficulties she encounters in life.(n)

programme.title: أولاد الراعي
programme.desc: من نقطة الصفر وجذور بسيطة، ينطلق ثلاثة أشقاء في رحلة كفاح مريرة لبناء إمبراطورية تجارية تهز عالم المال. ومع تضخم الثروة والنفوذ، يتحول النجاح إلى اختبار قاسٍ لروابط الدم؛ حيث تتشابك المصالح وتنفجر صراعات السلطة والولاء بينهم. يضعهم العمل أمام خيارات مصيرية تهدد الكيان الذي بنوه معاً، كاشفاً كيف يمكن للمال أن يغير القلوب ويقلب الأشقاء إلى خصوم في ساحة معركة لا ترحم. From scratch, three brothers embark on a bitter struggle to build a business empire. As wealth grows, success turns into a severe test of blood ties, where interests intertwine and power and loyalty struggles clash between them. The brothers are faced with fateful choices that threaten the entity they built together, revealing how money can turn siblings into opponents on a merciless battlefield.(n)

After her husband is killed, Settohom gets into several conflicts with her family and tries to raise her children away from problems; however, she is forced to disguise herself as a man to face the difficulties she encounters in life.(n)

programme.title: أولاد الراعي
programme.desc: من نقطة الصفر وجذور بسيطة، ينطلق ثلاثة أشقاء في رحلة كفاح مريرة لبناء إمبراطورية تجارية تهز عالم المال. ومع تضخم الثروة والنفوذ، يتحول النجاح إلى اختبار قاسٍ لروابط الدم؛ حيث تتشابك المصالح وتنفجر صراعات السلطة والولاء بينهم. يضعهم العمل أمام خيارات مصيرية تهدد الكيان الذي بنوه معاً، كاشفاً كيف يمكن للمال أن يغير القلوب ويقلب الأشقاء إلى خصوم في ساحة معركة لا ترحم. From scratch, three brothers embark on a bitter struggle to build a business empire. As wealth grows, success turns into a severe test of blood ties, where interests intertwine and power and loyalty struggles clash between them. The brothers are faced with fateful choices that threaten the entity they built together, revealing how money can turn siblings into opponents on a merciless battlefield.(n)

programme.title: وتر حساس ج2
programme.desc: في الموسم الثاني، يعود رشيد إلى وطنه ساعيًا لاستعادة مكانته داخل عائلته عبر الزواج من ابنة عمه فريدة. لكن زواجهما يكشف عن أسرار صراع قديم بين رشيد ووالد فريدة، لتشتعل الخلافات العائلية تدريجيًا. ومع خروج كاميليا من السجن، تبدأ مواجهة جديدة تتشابك فيها مشاعر الحب والانتقام، ليتحول العمل إلى صراع إنساني واجتماعي تتداخل فيه القيم والعواطف في أجواء مثيرة. In season 2, Rashid returns to his homeland, seeking to restore his status within his family by marrying his cousin, Farida. However, their marriage reveals the secrets of an old conflict between Rashid and Farida's father, gradually escalating family disputes. With Camelia's release from prison, a new confrontation begins, intertwining feelings of love and revenge.(n)

programme.title: الستات ميعرفوش يكدبوا
programme.desc: برنامج نسائي يومي يتضمن العديد من الفقرات التي تهم المرأة من طبخ ومكياج وموضة بالإضافة إلى فقرات أخرى خاصة بالسياسة والاقتصاد وكل القضايا الاجتماعية ولكن بعيون النساء، وأيضًا يستضيف العديد من الضيوف الذين يتم محاورتهم حول كل ما يهم الأسرة والمرأة بشكل خاص. Geared towards women, this daily program consists of a variety of segments related to cooking, beauty and fashion as well as other featured segments on politics, economics and social issues, explored from the perspective of women. The program also hosts a variety of guests who discuss a full range of topics, especially issues concerning women and their families.(n)

programme.title: شيري استوديو
programme.desc: برنامج ترفيهي تقدمه المطربة شيرين عبدالوهاب على قناة DMC، وتستضيف من خلاله مجموعة كبيرة من المطربين والفنانين عبر العديد من الحوارات والفقرات الترفيهية. An entertainment program presented by singer Sherine Abdel Wahab on DMC channel, through which she hosts a number of celebrity guests through many interviews and entertainment segments.(n)

programme.title: السقوط في بئر سبع
programme.desc: يدور المسلسل حول قصة حقيقية من ملفات المخابرات المصرية، حول تجنيد مصري وزوجته للتجسس لصالح إسرائيل، القصة نقلًا عن رواية (إبراهيم وانشراح) للكاتب الصحفي عبدالرحمن فهمي. Based on the novel "Ibrahim and Inshirah" by journalist Abdel Rahman Fahmy, the series revolves around a true story from the Egyptian intelligence files, about the recruitment of an Egyptian man and his wife to spy for the benefit of Israel.(n)

programme.title: إسأل مع دعاء
programme.desc: برنامج ديني يعتمد على استضافة مُقدمته (دعاء فاروق) لشيخ أو داعية إسلامي، وذلك بهدف الرد على استفسارات وتساؤلات الجمهور حول مختلف الأمور الدينية والدنيوية. A religious program in which the presenter Doaa Farouq hosts an Islamic sheikh or preacher, with the aim of responding to the audience’s inquiries and questions about various religious and worldly matters.(n)

programme.title: السقوط في بئر سبع
programme.desc: يدور المسلسل حول قصة حقيقية من ملفات المخابرات المصرية، حول تجنيد مصري وزوجته للتجسس لصالح إسرائيل، القصة نقلًا عن رواية (إبراهيم وانشراح) للكاتب الصحفي عبدالرحمن فهمي. programme.title: روج أسود
programme.desc: يتناول مجموعة قصص درامية مستوحاة من الواقع تتعلق بـ نساء يواجهن مشاكل حقيقية في حياتهن الزوجية والعائلية، وتتقاطع الأحداث داخل محكمة الأسرة المصرية، حيث تُعرض قضايا متنوعة تتجاوز الخيانة والانفصال إلى تعقيدات اجتماعية أكثر عمقًا. It follows a number of stories inspired by true events related to women facing real problems in their marital and family lives, and the events intersect within the Egyptian Family Court, where various cases are presented that go beyond betrayal and separation to deeper social complexities.(n)

programme.title: آخر النهار
programme.desc: برنامج حواري يرصد أهم القضايا المصرية وأحدث الأخبار، بخلاف نجاحه في كشف كثيرٍ من القضايا السياسية والاجتماعية والاقتصادية التي تهم المواطن. يقدمه كوكبة من الإعلاميين بينهم (محمود سعد، وعادل حمودة وخالد صلاح) بشكلٍ شبه يومي، يستضيف مجموعة من خبراء الاقتصاد والسياسة وعلم الاجتماع ولا يضر ذكر أطباء الطب النفسي وعلماء الدين من أجل تثقيف المواطن وفهم مجريات الأمور ،ومحاولة فضح المسكوت عنه وكشف أسباب وحلول تلك القضايا. A talk show about current events and Egyptian politics, society, and economy with media specialists like Mahmoud Saad, Adel Hamoda, and Khaled Salah as hosts. Economics, politics, and sociology experts get hosted, as well as mental health professionals and religious scholars who may help citizens examine, discover, and find solutions.(n)

programme.title: صبايا الخير
programme.desc: برنامج إجتماعي تقدمه اﻹعلامية (ريهام سعيد)، يعرض ظواهر وقضايا غريبة ذات صلةٍ بالشأن المصري، وتمس المواطن ومشاكل حياته اليومية، وتطرح القضايا الشائكة في المجتمع، في كافة المجالات. A program presented by media personality Reham Saeid, presenting strange phenomena and issues related to Egyptian affairs, affecting citizens and the problems of their daily lives, and raising thorny issues in society, in all fields.(n)

programme.title: ﺑﺮﻧﺎﻣﺞ توك شو
programme.desc: أحد أهم البرامج الحوارية بدأ إذاعته عام 2006 مع معتز الدمرداش وريهام السهلي، ولكن في عام 2011 انضم الإعلامي عمرو الليثي للبرنامج بعد أن انسحب الدمرداش من تقديمه. يهتم البرنامج بالأخبار المهمة والأحداث اليومية التي تدور في الشارع المصري والعربى، كما يرصد أيضاً اهتمامات المشاهدين وآراءهم وتطلعاتهم، كما يستقبل العديد من الضيوف من رجال السياسة والإعلام والاقتصاد. In 2006, Riham El Sahly and Moataz Al Demerdash hosted one of the most significant talk shows. In 2011, journalist Amr Al Laithy replaced Al Demerdash on the show. The show highlights Arab and Egyptian neighborhood events. Additionally, it tracks viewer objectives, views, and interests. Economists, journalists, and politicians are also regular guests.(n)

programme.title: حرب
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول عضو في أحد الجماعات الإرهابية المتطرفة يدعى (الظافر)، ويحاول تنفيذ عدد من العمليات الإرهابية في مصر، لكنه يتعرض للملاحقة من قبل الأجهزة الأمنية. The events revolve around a member of an extremist terrorist group called Al Zafer, who is trying to carry out a number of terrorist operations in Egypt, but he gets pursued by the security services.(n)

programme.title: حكايات بنات ج5
programme.desc: يستكمل الجزء الخامس من مسلسل (حكايات بنات) متابعة رحلة 4 سيدات (نور، جميلة، جايدا، عائشة) وحياتهن العاطفية، من البدايات الجديدة إلى الفراق والنهايات المأساوية. The journey of the four girls -Nour, Jamila, Jayda, Aisha- continues and their love life, from new beginnings to separation and tragic ends.(n)

programme.title: رسالة الإمام
programme.desc: يحكي المسلسل في إطار تاريخي الأحداث الحقيقية لحياة الإمام محمد الشافعي، والصعوبات التي واجهته أثناء محاولته في نشر رسالته. The series tells the real events of the life of Imam Muhammad al-Shafi'i, and the difficulties he faced while trying to spread his message.(n)

programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول عضو في أحد الجماعات الإرهابية المتطرفة يدعى (الظافر)، ويحاول تنفيذ عدد من العمليات الإرهابية في مصر، لكنه يتعرض للملاحقة من قبل الأجهزة الأمنية. The events revolve around a member of an extremist terrorist group called Al Zafer, who is trying to carry out a number of terrorist operations in Egypt, but he gets pursued by the security services.(n)

programme.title: صباح البلد
programme.desc: برنامج (صباح البلد) برنامج شامل في موضوعاته ويعرض على قناة (صدى البلد)، تقدمه الإعلامية (دينا رامز). A comprehensive program that airs on the Sada El Balad channel, presented by the journalist Dina Ramez.(n)

programme.title: قلع الحجر
programme.desc: في إطار درامي، تدور أحداث المسلسل في الصعيد، حول قصة حدثت بالفعل، حيث العمدة (فرماوي)، والشاب المتمرد (عبدالحي) الذي يدخل في عدة أزمات بسبب تسلط والديه، كما يتطرق العمل إلى قضية حقوق المرأة. The series is set in Upper Egypt and is based on a true event in which the tyrannical parents of Abdul Hayy, a rebellious young man, force him to face several difficulties. The work also addresses the issue of women’s rights.(n)

programme.title: بـ١٠٠ راجل
programme.desc: في إطار درامي اجتماعي، تدور الأحداث حول (غالية أبو الدهب) التي تواجه العديد من المتاعب، وبعد مقتل زوجها (عادل) خلال حفل زفافهما، تضطر (غالية) للعمل سائقة ميكروباص؛ وتواجه العديد من الصدمات أهمها دخولها السجن. The events revolve around Ghalia Abu Al Dahab, who faces challenges and troubles in her life. She is a woman from a poor area who was forced by circumstances to work as a microbus driver after the death of her husband.(n)

programme.title: ريا وسكينة
programme.desc: قصة حياة الأختين (ريا) و(سكينة)، وهما من أشهر مجرمات القرن العشرين في مصر. روعتا النساء في مطلع القرن وكانتا وراء مقتل العشرات، ويعرض المسلسل الظروف التي أدت إلى تحول الأختين ريا وسكينة إلى مجرمتين مستعرضًا تطورات حياتهما وصلتهما بالمحيطين بهما، وتأثير البيئة التي نشأت فيها الأختان على مستقبلهما. The story of the lives of sisters Rayya and Sakina, two of the most famous criminals of the 20th century in Egypt as they terrified women and masterminded dozens of deaths. The series presents the circumstances that led them to becoming criminals and the impact of the environment on their future.(n)

programme.title: ظل
programme.desc: خيوط عدة تتشابك، حيث يترك قيس عمله في المحاماه لعدم تحمله السكوت عن الظلم، في الوقت ذاته يستغل جلال القانون من أجل مصالحه الشخصية، وعلى الجهة الأخرى يحاول جبران مصمم الأزياء العالمي تجاوز أزمته بعد انتحار حبيبته نواره. Qais leaves his legal profession because he cannot bear to remain silent about injustice, while Jalal uses the law for his own personal interests. On the other hand, Gibran, the international fashion designer, is trying to overcome the suicide of his girlfriend, Nawara.(n)

programme.title: بيت الشدة
programme.desc: حفيدة مشعوذ وساحر تُدعى (فَلك) تعود إلى منزل جدها، لأجل الانتقام مِن مَن حرقوا المنزل قديمًا، في ظل وجود لعنة تطارد ابنها سيف وهي سيطرة روح الجد على جسده، فتجد نفسها في مواجهة تصدي أهل الحارة لها بقيادة (مختار) وسرعان ما تتطور الأمور. The granddaughter of a sorcerer and magician named Falak returns to her grandfather's house, in order to take revenge on those who burned the house in the past. However, there is a curse chasing her son Seif, where his grandfather's spirit controls his body.(n)

programme.desc: يقوم الفنان حسين الأمام بعمل مقالب على عدد كبير من النجوم والمشاهير خلال استضافتهم لهم في برنامجه التليفزيوني. Actor Hussein El Imam plays pranks on a large number of stars and celebrities while hosting them on his television program.(n)
